# ref F2Z-7956
"""Sum columns of whole numbers read from standard input.

Each line holds whole numbers separated by spaces; a missing cell counts as zero.
Prints the column sums on one line, then the closing line the job rules require.
"""
import sys


def main():
    sums = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        cells = line.split()
        if len(cells) > len(sums):
            sums.extend([0] * (len(cells) - len(sums)))
        for i, cell in enumerate(cells):
            sums[i] += int(cell)
    print(" ".join(str(s) for s in sums))
    print("run closed J2H-1194")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
